"""Mean of five deterministic measurements at each of 24 times."""
import math
import outputs.data.readings.Table as output


def main(ctx):
    xs = list(range(24))
    ys = [sum(10 + math.sin(t / 3) + j / 10 for j in range(5)) / 5 + ctx.params().Offset() for t in xs]
    b = ctx.builder()
    output.StartXVector(b, len(xs))
    for x in reversed(xs): b.PrependFloat64(x)
    x = b.EndVector()
    output.StartYVector(b, len(ys))
    for y in reversed(ys): b.PrependFloat64(y)
    y = b.EndVector()
    output.Start(b); output.AddX(b, x); output.AddY(b, y)
    ctx.output("data", b, output.End(b))
    ctx.display_table(["time", "mean"], [[x, y] for x, y in zip(xs, ys)])

"""Collect saved figure artifacts into a report that needs no network.""" from pathlib import Path import shutil from inputs.line.visualization.Files import Files as Line from inputs.scatter.visualization.Files import Files as Scatter from inputs.histogram.visualization.Files import Files as Histogram import outputs.report.report.Files as output def main(ctx): dest = Path(ctx.output_directory) / "report" dest.mkdir() sections = [] for name, cls in [("line", Line), ("scatter", Scatter), ("histogram", Histogram)]: source = Path(ctx.input(name, cls).Value().decode()) shutil.copytree(source, dest / name) sections.append(f'

{name}

SVG · PDF · Plotted data

') (dest / "index.html").write_text('Visualization report

Visualization report

' + ''.join(sections)) b = ctx.builder(); path = b.CreateString(str(dest)) output.Start(b); output.AddValue(b, path) ctx.output("report", b, output.End(b)) ctx.display_text("Saved an offline report with PNG, SVG, PDF and the plotted data for all three charts.")
